_doc: Biome palettes for the v3 terrain (T2, LAN-67). One per map. Slots follow terrain_splat.py CLASSES: ground, ground2, rock, cliff, scree, dust, forest, wet. All layers ambientCG CC0 1.0 (https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/); sources.json beside the downloaded maps records each. Chosen to the style notes (plan section 10): one restrained hue per map, variation in value and roughness.
